project_type: Node ESM TypeScript MCP server (Express + @modelcontextprotocol v2). Per-request McpServer created inside an Auth0-protected POST /mcp handler. Adding a new React + Tailwind 4 + esbuild web/ build pipeline for two interactive UI widgets.
language: TypeScript (ES2022, ESM). Server runs via tsx (no emit). Widgets are React 18/19 TSX bundled by esbuild.
build_system: Server: `npm start` = `tsx src/index.ts` (no build/typecheck on start). UI: new esbuild script (web/build.mjs) + @tailwindcss/cli for CSS. tsconfig: module Node16, moduleResolution Node16, rootDir ./src, outDir ./build, strict true. QUIRK: rootDir is ./src, so web/ MUST live outside src/ and the UI must NOT import from ../src (duplicate the Product types into web/src/types.ts). QUIRK: ALL relative TS imports in src/ MUST use the .js extension (Node16 ESM convention already used throughout src/).
test_framework: None installed. No test runner, no linter. Verification is: `npm run build:ui` (UI bundles build), `npx tsc --noEmit` (server type-checks), and `npm start` boots and logs the startup line.
build_command: npm run build:ui  (and for server type-check: npx tsc --noEmit)
test_command: npx tsc --noEmit   (there is no unit-test suite; type-check + boot is the gate)
verification_instructions: 1) `npm run build:ui` exits 0 and produces non-empty web/dist/explore-product.js and web/dist/get-product-by-id.js, each containing the React bundle AND inlined CSS. 2) `npx tsc --noEmit` exits 0 (server compiles, no references to deleted files/symbols). 3) `npm start` logs 'PayAlly MCP Server started'. 4) Confirm src/index.ts STILL has the AuthInfo tool and the getUserProfile import (they must NOT be removed) and now also registers both new tools. Full /mcp tool-call smoke test requires a valid Auth0 bearer token; if unavailable, instead assert each ui:// resource HTML string contains '<div id="root">' and '<script type="module">' and that bundles are non-empty, and document the limitation.
snapshot_or_generated_files: web/dist/<name>.js are generated by `npm run build:ui` and are inlined by the server at resource-registration time via readFileSync. They are NOT committed in a worktree sense but must exist before `npm start` reads them (a `prestart` script runs build:ui). .gitignore currently ignores only /node_modules and .env; consider adding /build and web/dist.
environment_constraints: The /mcp route is Auth0-protected (requireAuth middleware) — a tool call needs a valid bearer token. Required env vars (see .env / .env.example): AUTH0_DOMAIN (required, throws if missing), AUTH0_AUDIENCE, AUTH0_MGMT_CLIENT_ID, AUTH0_MGMT_CLIENT_SECRET, PAYPAL_MERCHANT_ID (sample value DZWR8V78BHZ6G), PORT (default 3001). Windows + PowerShell dev environment.
contribution_requirements: No AGENTS.md/CONTRIBUTING/.kiro steering files exist. Conventions inferred from code: ESM with .js import extensions in src/, 4-space indent in root src files, per-path imports for apps-sdk-ui components. Keep the AuthInfo tool, all Auth0 middleware, and the getUserProfile import intact — the user did NOT ask to remove AuthInfo; just add the two new tool registrations beside it.
key_patterns: ext-apps server helpers: registerAppTool(server,name,config,cb) + registerAppResource(server,name,uri,config,readCb), RESOURCE_MIME_TYPE='text/html;profile=mcp-app', all from '@modelcontextprotocol/ext-apps/server'. Tool->view link via config._meta.ui.resourceUri. inputSchema/outputSchema as z.object({...}). CSP lives on the RESOURCE content item (_meta.ui.csp = { connectDomains:['https://api.payally.world'], resourceDomains:['https://cdn.trychannel3.com'] }) NOT on the tool (McpUiToolMeta.csp is `never`). annotations:{readOnlyHint:true,openWorldHint:true}. _meta also carries 'openai/toolInvocation/invoking' + 'openai/toolInvocation/invoked' strings. View side (React): useApp({appInfo,capabilities:{}}) + useHostStyles(app, app?.getHostContext()) from '@modelcontextprotocol/ext-apps/react'; subscribe via app.addEventListener('toolresult', p => ...) inside useApp's onAppCreated; read p.structuredContent (toolresult params is a CallToolResult). Embla React: const [emblaRef,emblaApi]=useEmblaCarousel({align:'start',dragFree:true,containScroll:'trimSnaps'}); ref on viewport; scrollPrev/scrollNext/canScrollPrev/canScrollNext; emblaApi.on('select'|'reInit',...); drag is default-on. apps-sdk-ui global CSS must start with: @import 'tailwindcss'; @import '@openai/apps-sdk-ui/css'; @source '<path-to>/node_modules/@openai/apps-sdk-ui'; (the @source path is relative to the CSS file's location). Confirmed apps-sdk-ui components: Badge, Image, Icon (Star, StarFilled, ChevronLeft, ChevronRight, ShoppingBag, Tag), EmptyMessage — import per path e.g. '@openai/apps-sdk-ui/components/Badge'. Server reads bundle via fileURLToPath(import.meta.url)+readFileSync; from src/tools/*.ts the bundle is at ../../web/dist/<name>.js.
